name: Bvlgari Hotel London
insider_take: Where Italian glamour meets British sophistication in Knightsbridge's most coveted address.
whats_special: This ultra-luxe property occupies a stunning Art Deco building that once housed Harrods' furniture repository. The hotel features London's first Bvlgari Spa with a 25-meter swimming pool lined with shimmering silver mosaics, plus suites designed with Italian marble and handcrafted furnishings. The rooftop bar offers panoramic views of Hyde Park and the London skyline.
pro_tip: Book the Bvlgari Suite for exclusive access to the hotel's private garden terrace – one of London's most secluded outdoor spaces in the heart of Knightsbridge.
dont_miss: The signature afternoon tea featuring Bvlgari-inspired pastries, and a stroll through nearby Hyde Park's Italian Gardens. Harrods department store is literally next door, while the Victoria and Albert Museum and Royal Albert Hall are just minutes away on foot.
pros: Exceptional luxury Italian design and craftsmanship throughout
Prime Knightsbridge location near Harrods and Hyde Park
World-class spa and wellness facilities with signature treatments
Michelin-starred dining and sophisticated bar experiences
cons: Intimate boutique size with limited availability
